title: Verify ordinary task-sync recovery after an uncertain push
outcome: Exercise non-retryable Git failure receipts and the next invocation's observation of a remote that may already hold the commit.
acceptance: A CLI behavior test simulates an accepted update with a lost response, checks the pending result, and verifies a rerun observes the already-published commit without redispatching it.
A focused behavioral classifier test recognizes an exact ref-update rejection as the retryable known refusal and leaves ambiguous failures pending.
